purpose: Pilot material only; not adopted in runtime, not approved final hero design
prompt:
Create ONE seamless square diffuse ALBEDO textile material for the navy male mage coat in Guardians of Nature. Use the attached USER GAME REFERENCE as the authoritative restrained realistic forest-fantasy style, the attached HERO SELECTION image (right-side young male mage) for dark navy woven cloth, and the actual current game image only as the negative example of overly flat featureless cloth. This is a physical cloth material used on the EXISTING SAME 3D male mage rig, NOT a new character, garment illustration, sprite, screenshot, UI or UV atlas. Preserve the dark blue identity, without adding ornaments.

OUTPUT: a single perfectly tileable square opaque RGB fabric texture filling the entire image, orthographic straight-on close-up of a flat material swatch, ideally1024x1024. No borders, no margins, no transparency, no checkerboard, no text, no symbols, no clothing silhouettes, no buttons, buckles, straps, gold trim or objects. All four opposite edges must join seamlessly in repeated tiles. It must be a materially quiet base layer with uniform soft neutral diffuse lighting: no cast shadows, no directional sun streaks, no vignette, no strong folds with baked light/shadow, no gradients that reveal repetition.

MATERIAL: realistic medium-weight dark NAVY BLUE wool-linen coat cloth, softly worn, subtle fine diagonal textile weave and tiny irregular thread fibers, gentle matte nap, restrained desaturated blue-gray variations. The navy should be readable rather than almost black: main luminance roughly15–25%, low local contrast, around dark navy RGB40,51,69 with natural blue-gray small variation. Add only sparse subtle non-directional wear and very shallow tiny fiber relief, never thick noisy burlap, metallic shine, denim seams, plastic smoothness or exaggerated coarse threads. It should remain visibly woven at the close character pixel density but become quiet at mobile gameplay scale. No image-specific 2.5D perspective baked into this material; the existing orthographic 120degree isometric render camera supplies all projection and lighting. The square depicts albedo/material detail only, not a scene or lit cloth with deep wrinkle shadows.
review: Single square navy woven albedo, no silhouette, props, lighting plate or baked 2.5D perspective; preserve original generated PNG. Runtime remains unchanged until pilot render comparison.
